instruction: Broken Scene Repair `/home/user/Desktop/scene.blend` is the initial Blender scene. It suffers from five concrete, common issues. Fix ALL of them and save the repaired result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` (relative to the working directory). A diagnostic script `_internal/inspect.py` is provided. You can run it to get a JSON report of the issues it detects: blender --background --python _internal/inspect.py -- --blend /home/user/Desktop/scene.blend It will emit a line beginning with `INSPECT_REPORT:` followed by JSON of the form `{"issue_count": N, "issues": [...]}`. After fixing, re-run it against your answer.blend and confirm `issue_count == 0`. ## The 5 issues to fix 1. Hidden mesh. Object `HiddenMesh` (a UV sphere at Z=3) has `show_viewport = False`. Fix: set `HiddenMesh.show_viewport = True`. 2. Broken image path. Material `Mat_Broken` on `TexturedPlane` has an Image Texture node whose image datablock has `filepath = "//missing.png"`, which does not resolve to any file on disk. A valid replacement PNG is provided at `/home/user/Desktop/textures/good_texture.png`. Fix: copy it to `/home/user/Desktop/good_texture.png` and repoint the broken image's `filepath` to `//good_texture.png` (copy the PNG next to `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` so `//` resolves), call `image.reload()`, and then `image.pack()` so the pixels survive save-close-reopen. 3. Offset transform. Object `MainMesh` (a cube) has its vertices authored at the origin but its OBJECT `location` is `(3, 0, 0)`, giving it an offset transform. Fix: reset `MainMesh.location = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)`. 4. Material with nodes disabled. Material `Mat_NoNodes` on `PrincipledBall` has `use_nodes = False` (it uses the legacy viewport diffuse color). Fix: set `Mat_NoNodes.use_nodes = True` and build a minimal shader graph: a Principled BSDF node wired into a Material Output node (you can clear any leftover nodes and create a fresh pair). 5. Extra empty collection. Collection `Extra_Collection` exists under the scene root but is empty and redundant. Fix: unlink it from the scene root and remove the datablock with `bpy.data.collections.remove(...)`. (If Blender refuses to remove a linked collection, first call `bpy.context.scene.collection.children.unlink(coll)`.) ## Do not - Do not rename any of the existing objects (`HiddenMesh`, `MainMesh`, `TexturedPlane`, `PrincipledBall`), materials (`Mat_Broken`, `Mat_NoNodes`), the camera, or the light. - Do not delete the camera or the light. - Do not change the mesh topology of any object. - Do not introduce new broken image paths. ## Requirements 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` exists and opens as a valid Blender file. 2. `HiddenMesh.show_viewport == True`. 3. Every non-builtin image datablock resolves to a file on disk OR is packed into the blend (no missing images). 4. `MainMesh.location` is approximately `(0, 0, 0)` (within 0.01 on each axis). 5. `Mat_NoNodes.use_nodes == True` and the material's node tree contains a Principled BSDF node. 6. `bpy.data.collections` does NOT contain any collection named `Extra_Collection`. 7. All four meshes (`HiddenMesh`, `MainMesh`, `TexturedPlane`, `PrincipledBall`) are still present as mesh objects. 8. The scene still has an active camera and at least one light object. [Software] Launch Blender by running `blender` from a terminal.
